subject: Osteroid
text: On entering the room, attack and jump to dodge Osteroid's four purple balls.

evidence.quote: As Soon as you enter the room, attack and jump dodge his four purple balls

subject: Osteroid
text: Watch the range of Osteroid's purple balls if he stands up.

subject: Osteroid
text: Osteroid sometimes changes his pattern when you enter the room and step forward, which can mess up your timing.

subject: Osteroid
text: Stay at the start firing until Osteroid reaches the edge, then work your way over while attacking to keep him there.

evidence.quote: Just stay at the start firing til he gets to the edge then carefully work your way over while attacking to keep him there

subject: Osteroid
text: Osteroid's firing pattern has some randomness, but it should not take more than a few tries.

subject: Zoda Prime
text: Stay on the squares and never be in line of Zoda Prime's sight.

evidence.quote: Just like the video shows, stay on the squares and never be in line of Zoda's sight

subject: Zoda Prime
text: Stand one square diagonally from Zoda Prime, wait for him to jump in line with you, hit him once, then hop away.

evidence.quote: Always try to be standing one square diagonally from where Zoda is and wait for him to jump in line with you, hit him once and hop away

subject: Zoda Prime
text: Staying close to Zoda Prime keeps him from dropping the little noodle balls.

evidence.quote: As long as you stay close he never drops the little noodle balls and is a pretty simple fight

subject: Zoda Prime
text: Be careful when Zoda Prime leaves the squares himself, and be patient for him to come after you again.

evidence.quote: Just be careful when he leaves the squares himself and just be patient for him to come after you again

subject: Zoda Prime
text: A commenter found that getting the Super Laser made the Zoda Prime fight a lot easier.

evidence.quote: I found that getting the super laser and fighting him made it a lot easier

subject: Zoda Prime
text: Empty the normal laser before the boss room so you do not have to cycle through 3 weapons.

evidence.quote: Prior to the boss room I would empty out my normal laser so I didn't have to cycle through 3 weapons

subject: Zoda Prime
text: Hit Zoda Prime's spawns with the Super Nova, then switch to the Super Laser to get 3 hits per jump.

evidence.quote: Then hitting the Zoda spawns with the Super Nova switching to the super laser to get 3 hits per jump on him

subject: Zoda Prime
text: Doing this reduces Zoda Prime to about 10 Super Nova hits afterward.

evidence.quote: Doing this makes him like 10 hits with the super nova after
